lexical.$entitiesComment: The first three are what the two E8 decks contained. The fourth is a follow-up measurement taken on 2026-08-27 against the same build: a deck authored through PowerPoint COM with a shape renamed 'a "quoted" name' was saved, and PowerPoint wrote name="a "quoted" name" - two occurrences of " and no other entity anywhere in the package. E8's decks simply had no attribute with a quote in it, so their silence about " was never evidence. The counts above still describe the E8 decks only.

text.$comment: The second run was authored with two leading and two trailing spaces. PowerPoint preserves them and writes NO xml:space attribute, unlike WordprocessingML, where a w:t with edge whitespace carries one.

runs.text: Ampersand & less < greater > quote " apostrophe ' end

ole.$comment: Experiment E6. Build 2205 stopped writing the VML fallback for OLE. This build still writes the mc:AlternateContent wrapper, and its mc:Choice still requires the VML prefix, but there is no vmlDrawing part and no @spid for it to point at.
